svg.title: On-premises Blob DNS: normal resolution and VPN failover
svg.desc: The preferred West Europe resolver answers queries for both Blobs. Then the West Europe VPN goes down. An uncached Israel Blob query times out, on-premises DNS retries through the Israel Central VPN, and the fallback resolver returns the same 10.42.19.10 from the shared private zone.

g.text: The on-premises forwarder sends the name to its preferred West Europe resolver.
Azure DNS follows the CNAME, reads the shared zone, and returns the private IP.
The name matches the same forwarding rule and goes to West Europe again.
West Europe reads the Israel Blob record in the same zone and returns its private IP.
5 / West Europe VPN goes down: no DNS reply
An uncached Israel Blob lookup gets no response from the preferred endpoint.
6 / On-premises DNS retries via Israel Central
After the timeout, the forwarder sends the same name to its fallback inbound endpoint.
Israel Central reads the same private zone and replies over the Israel VPN.

svg.text: Timing is illustrative. DNS failover returns an IP; it does not guarantee connectivity to that IP.
